body: @vicb can you own this? please look into it today and determine if we must fix this in a39 (due tomorrow/wed). On the surface this looks serious enough that it should be in 39.
Not sure if I can find time to look at this today. If not, I'll check it first thing tomorrow.

The pb is in `var target = isWebWorker() && !this ? self : this;` which returns undefined while it should return the `window` when Polymer does `addEventListener('WebComponentsReady', resolve);`

I'll try to come with a fix ASAP

issue.title: `addEventListener` in strict mode
issue.body:
When `addEventListener` is called in strict mode, `var target = isWebWorker() && !this ? self : this` would evaluate to `undefined` in `patchEventTargetMethods()` resulting in an error.

Notes:
- in non strict mode, `this` would be set to `window` and there would be no error,
- `window.addEventListener()` would work in both strict & non-strict mode.

/ref https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/4531

issue.title: fix(addEventListener): when called from the global scope
issue.body:
fixes #190
